name: Free Electricity Supply Scheme
benefit: - **Free Electricity Supply:** Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe farmers having agricultural pumps up to 5 horsepower and landholding up to 1 hectare receive free electricity.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - The applicant must be a farmer owning agricultural land up to 1 hectare. - The applicant must have an agricultural pump of capacity up to 5 Horsepower (HP).
